items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: No, not until he got up to Alvin Bowers (phonetic); then it was good.

ctx.x: Instead of you hearing a solid teamwork. Now this is where I say Walter Page came in. After those bands, you heard Earl Hines in his early days. He had all the beautiful arrangements, and he sounded so beautiful on the piano. He had a good rhythm section, but he wasn't even.
No, not until he got up to Alvin Bowers (phonetic); then it was good.
